paragraph: Submit your program's rules and let Scheduling Wizard's managed service deliver your finished schedules built to the ACGME requirements.

cta.title: Get Your Physician Schedules Done Right
cta.description: Book a call to talk through your scheduling needs and learn how Scheduling Wizard works. Join 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices that have us build their call, block, clinic and shift schedules.

faq.answer: Automated physician scheduling means building the schedule from the program's rules rather than building them manually in spreadsheets. Scheduling Wizard takes this further as a fully managed service: programs submit their rules, and our team produces finished Block, Call, Clinic, and Attending schedules delivered as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you. No scheduling software is required on the program's end.
faq.question: What is automated physician scheduling and how does it work?

faq.answer: It is built to the ACGME requirements you tell us apply, alongside your own rules, and we check the finished schedule against them before it goes out. The review on your side is a check, not a repair job. Our team applies the 80-hour weekly limit, the rest requirements between duty periods, the 24-hour cap, and the subspecialty rules you tell us apply. This means the rules are applied before the schedule reaches your program, rather than detected and corrected post-hoc.
faq.question: Is a schedule from Scheduling Wizard ACGME compliant?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard operates as a done-for-you managed service, meaning the building is done by our team. Chief residents and program coordinators do not need to learn or operate any scheduling software. Programs provide their rules and requirements, and Scheduling Wizard delivers the finished, ready-to-publish schedule.
faq.question: Who handles the scheduling process at Scheduling Wizard?

faq.answer: When unplanned changes occur, such as sick leave, parental leave, or a coverage change, Scheduling Wizard can rebuild the affected portions of the schedule without reshuffling the entire year. Your rules are written down, so a mid-year rebuild follows the same rules as the original.
faq.question: How are mid-year changes or resident absences handled?

faq.answer: Yes. It is entirely up to you. We build the schedule either way, and deliver it in the format and structure you want: Excel or Google Sheets, or a custom live view we build for you if that is useful. Many programs keep the platform they already have for day-to-day viewing and upload our schedules straight into it; others use the live view, or both. Whatever works best for your program.
faq.question: Can Scheduling Wizard work alongside your existing platform?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard generates four schedule types: Block and rotation schedules, Call schedules with fair call distribution, Clinic schedules coordinated against rotation and call obligations, and Attending schedules aligned with resident assignments. All four are built together to the same set of rules, so changes in one schedule type propagate across the others.

hero.title: Automated Physician Scheduling Without the Software

items.title: Built to Your Rules, However Granular
items.description: We build to your rules and requests, however complex or granular: the written ones, including the ACGME requirements where they apply, and the local ones nobody has written down. The attending who does not take Friday call. The two residents who cannot share a rotation. The clinic that needs Thursdays protected. If you can describe it, it goes in.

searchIntents: As a chief resident, I'm overwhelmed with the complexity of creating compliant schedules every year, and I need a service that can handle all the ACGME requirements without me spending weeks learning how to use scheduling software.

I'm a program director looking for an efficient way to generate fair clinic and call schedules that take into account our residents' preferences and the ACGME duty hour rules, rather than struggling with generic tools that don't cater to our specific needs.

As a program coordinator, I want a solution that ensures continuity in scheduling knowledge across chief rotations, so we don't lose critical scheduling information every year when new chiefs take over.

I'm an administrator in a private practice searching for a managed service that can create finished schedules without gaps or overstaffing, which is a common issue with self-service scheduling platforms. I need something tailored to our unique needs without adding more software for my team.
